code_readback.clip_source_field_not_applicable: core/drama.mjs rejects data.source for a still; data.source is for an earlier clip, not shared still pictures.
code_readback.native_supported_route: keyframes --shot plus the ordinary exact-request media cache; no invented shot field, manifest copy or CLI modification
code_readback.cache_identity: Stage.imageKey uses provider/model/composed prompt/negative/references/seed/size (plus image-selection version); id, shot_id and target do not enter this key. Stage.generate reads cached(workdir,key), which hashes actual existing bytes, before a new provider submission.
code_readback.camera_matters: composeShotPrompt appends camera, therefore each teaser also copies the payoff camera.
code_readback.judge_scope: Each scene still receives its own official judge decision. A cache hit avoids an image repurchase; it is not a shared or forged judge approval.

preconditions: Exact current source and narrative reviews, owner script/outline approvals, real production admission and whole-film quote remain required. Nothing in this plan starts paid work.
Keep the same immutable project/workdir, model selection version, look, composed prompt, references, image size, seed and empty correction list at the two ends.

Generate each payoff first through official keyframes --shot with --takes 1 and default seed offset 0. Proceed to its teaser only after that exact first take passed and remains the selected actual image.

production_handoff.on_any_failure_or_changed_request: Stop the pair. Do not let one end roll to another seed, acquire an independently corrected look-alike, use --force/--accept-best to bypass a failed review, or hand-edit a manifest. If a shared prompt needs a factual/style correction, update both ends together and repeat the normal source/visual binding and admitted generation process within the existing account and take caps.
actual_verification_required: Read the official keyframes manifest after both commands; require equal selected file paths and SHA256 for the pair, then hash the actual referenced bytes.
If trimming occurred, require both selected entries to reference the identical derived file and actual file SHA; the original generated-file hash alone is insufficient.
Require both official scene verdicts to pass (or the already authorized ordinary review route), and preserve the real image job/cache/ledger receipts.
A matching prompt or matching request key alone does not establish completed image reuse. No current result can be called image acceptance or media QA.
